alterations.description: Scene of Surekha going mad, where her emphasized bust is seen after her sari has fallen down.

producer: C. M. Trivedi, Kala Kendra, Marzban Road, Andheri, Bombay.

alterations.description: Close-up of Pingala with her emphasized bust uncovered while she talks to Bharathari on the river bank.
Another close-up of Pingala after the whip in Ashvapati's hand turns into a snake.
Four close-ups of Pingala where she gives the anarphal to Ashvapati. (Portion of one close-up retained for continuity).
Song line 'Man diya jise opou. magma Lein kiya u-d ko nawntu, man dekar tan ko kyon roko' repeated by Pingala in the sequence of her giving anarphal to Ashvapal.
Ashvapal pressing Pingala's legs.
Burning of Pingala's body.
Pingala and Bharathari riding on horse back.
Miscellaneous trimming.
Superimposed dhotis of Pingala's have sequence.
Sound of kissing of Roxana by Jason wherever it occurs.
View of Roxana's uncovered bust as she is carried by the pirate over his shoulder.
Dialogues of Baidu and Omar regarding Roxana from 'knowing your interest in rare merchandise...' to 'A tasty morsel should always be well served'.
Dialogues from 'Oh, very young my lord' to 'I will buy her' and accompanying presentation.
Close shot of Lilith in maroon-coloured brassiere revealing emphasized bust, preceding Jason's shot 'Goodnight'. Word 'Merchandise' as referred to Jason in respect of a slave girl (sound erased).

Sequence of the slave girls at Baidu's place and the dialogues in respect of them between Jason and Baidu, retaining Baidu's words 'I can see...' to 'household' along with the dialogues from the point Jason says 'I seek the one jewel...' dominating therefrom the shot of the mirror reflecting the girls seated in the balcony.

Sequence of Roxana's first appearance in Omar's harem attired in white transparent dress, retaining her in the first long shot, in the shot where the first girl refers to the wager between the Sultan and the marksman, in the shot in which Roxana enquires about the marksman as well as her dialogues with the group of girls from 'Truly the New Land is filled with savages...' to '...what is left to converse about:', retaining, in addition, only the portion of her scene with Omar's servant showing him delivering the message and her asking him to get out while flinging the vase at him, deleting all intervening and following shots exploiting her figure.
Kissing scene of Roxana and Jason following latter's duel with Omar. (Completely deleted).
The fight between Roxana and Lilith particularly deleting exposure of their legs.

The following words from the commentary: 'Within the first hour, the Communist delegations start, a procedural wrangle in effort to change the composition of the Conference'. (The corresponding words in Bengali have also been deleted).
Considerably the fight between a young crocodile and a young animal, maintaining the minimum for continuity.
The screaming of the girl captured by the ape-man.
All dialogue between Selim and the soldiers about the price and purchase of Selim's niece.
Jara asking Banning to kiss her, retaining it only once.
Shot of the woman in the chair suggesting apparent nudity.
The mating scenes in the item 'Battle Cry' and 'Talisman' eliminating from the latter sound of kissing. To a flash the oriental dance.
Considerably Adams making love to Gladys when he takes her to his apartment, keeping the minimum necessary for continuity.

producer: Paramount Films of India Ltd., Hague Building, Ballard Estate, Bombay.

alterations.description: The words 'BHARAT SARKARKO DILLI OHHOHNI PADI, MANTRIYON KI RABHA EK KAIL KE DIBBE MEN HUI ; HINDU SAMAJ KE LAKHON PARIVAR ATMARAKSHA KE LIVE HIMALAYA GAR OHAL BADE'.
Dialogue saying 'You must be on guard against...'
In the flash-back sequence, when the woman seeks to protect her virtue from the villain, deleted (the words of modern women will not be relevant).
In Range, Much song 'Summa- Irukathungu' deleted the words 'do not get kicked by policemen's boots'.
Reduce considerably the sequence where Murthy makes proposals to Malathi, and delete her reference to her Convent education before she took to impurity.
Delete the entire sequence of Rangamma asking Lakshmi for a kiss, including sound and picture.
Delete the close-up shots of Raghu's bleeding face, except once by way of suggestion for the story.
Delete the sound of the dagger cutting into Ram (out field) (sound only).
Reduce the length of the second sequence when Malathi and Lakshmi are shown fighting and grappling with each other.
